instructions.original_snippets: Enable strict: true plus additional strictness flags (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, etc.)
instructions.content: Enable strict: true and layer on additional strictness flags beyond the baseline for stronger guarantees.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER disable a strict-mode finding instead of fixing the underlying type model
instructions.content: Never disable a strict-mode finding with @ts-ignore or strict: false; fix the type model or configuration instead, since the defect is still there either way.

instructions.original_snippets: module and moduleResolution must be a matching pair for the project's runtime module system
instructions.content: Set module and moduleResolution as a matching pair appropriate to the project's actual runtime module system (CommonJS vs native ESM); a mismatched pair causes resolution errors even when each option looks individually reasonable.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER guess at a performance fix before profiling
instructions.content: Never change include/exclude patterns or restructure code to fix slow type-checking before running tsc --extendedDiagnostics (or --generateTrace) to see what is actually slow.

Diagnose a compiler performance problem with the compiler's own diagnostic output before changing configuration, since the actual bottleneck (e.g. type instantiation from a recursive conditional type) is often not what intuition suggests.
